items.headline: Lithium price 'chill' returns, JPMorgan downgrades Albemarle (ALB.US) earnings forecast and cuts target price to $140
items.snippet: Albemarle's Greenbushes CGP3 plant in Australia continues to face delays after a fire in June. JPMorgan believes that Albemarle's current stock price is close to its target price, and the valuation is reasonable for a high-quality but volatile lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal

items.headline: Albemarle Stock Slides 28% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.snippet: Albemarle is well-placed to gain from long-term growth in the battery-grade lithium market. ALB expects lithium demand to witness a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares.
